limit_description: Terra glows with unstable crystal light. For 1 round, her next offensive spell deals an extra 2d6 damage of the spell's type, and she gains resistance to that same damage type until the start of her next turn.
backstory:
Background: Crystal-Touched Scholar

Traits: Brilliant, quiet, intense, socially awkward, fascinated by forgotten magic.
Goals: Discover why the crystals react to her presence, protect Locke from his own terrible ideas, and decode the ancient summon script.
Quirks: Accidentally says terrifying things in a calm voice. Takes notes during combat.
repeating_cantrips_-C000000000000000001_: Ranged spell attack to deal 1d10 fire damage.
repeating_cantrips_-C000000000000000002_: Create a spectral hand that can manipulate objects up to 30 ft away.
repeating_inventory_-i000000000000000009: Contains: backpack, book of lore, ink bottle, ink pen, 10 sheets of parchment, small sand bag, small knife.
repeating_materia_-m_shield_materia_desc:
1st-level Abjuration
Casting Time: 1 reaction, which you take when you are hit by an attack or targeted by the spell Magic Missile
Range: Self
Components: V, S
Duration: 1 round

An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you.

Until the start of your next turn, you have:
+5 bonus to AC
including against the triggering attack.

You take no damage from:
Magic Missile
repeating_materia_-m_missile_materia_des:
1st-level Evocation
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 120 feet
Components: V, S
Duration: Instantaneous

You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range.
A dart deals: 1d4 + 1 force damage.
The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using additional MP, the spell creates one more dart for each extra MP spent above 1.
